svg.title: Display-P3 to sRGB controlled gamut-mapping comparison
svg.desc: A synthetic 125-color study separating the effect of mapping coordinates from the effect of the mapping algorithm, with common outcome diagnostics.
svg.text: 125-point controlled study: coordinates and algorithms change one at a time
radial clip vs experimental protected-core compression
Lab radial → OkLCh radial isolates coordinates; OkLCh radial → Local MINDE isolates algorithm.
Common metrics: CIEDE2000 displacement and IPT hue-coordinate difference.
Coordinate diagnostics are not observer validation; ideal encoding gamuts are not measured-device gamuts.
